name: TesterArmy
description: YC P26 startup providing AI-powered testing platform for web and mobile apps. name: MiMo Code
description: Xiaomi's terminal-based AI coding agent built on OpenCode with explicit long-term memory architecture. Features layered memory system (session, project, global, history), Max Mode for parallel sampling with 5 candidates, Goal completion verification, and Dynamic Workflow for orchestration. Demonstrates 65%+ win rate against Claude Code on tasks exceeding 200 steps. Open-sourced under MIT license.
